description: This Kotlin source file defines the TaskViewModel class, managing task-related data and operations for a to-do list application. It interacts with a repository to handle categories and tasks, maintains live data for the UI, and provides functions for filtering, adding, updating, and deleting tasks and categories.

classes.name: TaskViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class managing task and category data for the To-Do List application, providing functions to manipulate and filter tasks and categories.

methods.name: refreshAll
methods.description: Reloads categories and tasks, then applies current filters.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the search query string and applies filters.

methods.name: setSelectedCategoryName
methods.description: Sets the selected category for filtering tasks.

methods.name: ensureDefaultCategory
methods.description: Ensures default categories 'Personal' and 'Work' exist, creating them if necessary, then reloads data.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Adds a new category with the specified name.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task and calls a callback with its ID.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task.

methods.name: loadTasks
methods.description: Loads all tasks from the repository.

methods.name: loadCategories
methods.description: Loads all categories from the repository.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Applies current query and category filters to the task list.
